en-US.whatsNew:
Widgets now load albums of any size.

• Fixed widgets staying blank on albums with lots of photos
• Large widgets show big albums at full sharpness
• Big albums play every photo once before the order starts again
• Widgets with big libraries load faster
en-US.promotionalText: Free forever. No ads, no subscriptions, no paywall, no limits. Unlimited albums, a different album on every widget, and photos that change on their own all day.
